resources.string: Enter a base name and review every resulting filename. Only local display names and their related metadata are updated; original media bytes, URIs and the capture namespace are preserved. Editing this field does not write any files.
LOCAL rename only: remote copies are not renamed. Pending transfers of the previous version require attention and will not continue automatically. Verified remote history is retained.
Enter a valid base name to preview every filename. Renaming is unavailable for an unsupported or ambiguous file set.
Current name unknown; refresh and inspect the file.
Renaming is in progress. Cancellation is no longer available; wait for the verified result. Leaving this screen does not stop an operation already confirmed.
The complete local file set was renamed. Remote copies were not renamed.
Renaming failed; the previous filenames and related metadata bytes were restored. Review the result before a new attempt.
The local change was not completed or fully restored. Review each observed name before taking further action.
Renaming was rejected before a complete update. Refresh the catalog and review the selection.
The rename outcome is unknown. Do not assume that names or metadata were restored. Refresh the catalog and inspect every file.
A catalog refresh was requested. No result is inferred from a loading or read error.
